payload.title: Important AI News in the Last Month

sections.heading: Answer
sections.body: Pope Leo XIV stated that concerns about AI going rogue are not 'fake news' and should be taken seriously [E1], while President Donald Trump characterized those concerns as a 'hoax' [E2]. Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei warned that within six to 12 months AI could be capable of leading a swarm of agents that could take over the entire internet [E3]. Omega Healthcare's Prior Authorization Submission Agent, powered by UiPath, has reduced handling time by up to 75%, increased first-pass approvals by up to 20%, and achieved approximately 90% document extraction accuracy, thereby avoiding preventable denials and improving operational and financial performance for customers [E4]. The AI Breakthrough Award was created to recognize customers that have moved beyond automation as a cost-reduction exercise and toward AI-driven transformation that reshapes how their organizations operate [E5]. AI achieved its first meaningful breakthrough in theoretical physics, with an AI model surpassing the previous human limit by calculating a quantum field theory amplitude to nine-loop order [E6][E7]. Claude Fable, running version 5.1 in science mode, achieved theoretical results that even professionals in more advanced fields could not [E8].

citations.span: Pope Leo XIV said Monday that concerns about artificial intelligence going rogue are not "fake news" and should be taken seriously, insisting that safety issues raised by AI experts should be discussed and acted on.
President Donald Trump has called concerns about AI going rogue a "hoax."
Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, for example, has warned that within six to 12 months AI could be capable of leading a swarm of agents that could take over the entire internet.

Omega Healthcare's Prior Authorization Submission Agent, powered by UiPath, has reduced handling time by up to 75%, increased first-pass approvals by up to 20%, and achieved approximately 90% document extraction accuracy — avoiding preventable denials and improving operational and financial performance for customers.

The AI Breakthrough Award was created to recognize customers that have moved beyond automation as a cost-reduction exercise and toward AI-driven transformation that reshapes how their organizations operate.
AI makes its first meaningful breakthrough in theoretical physics
In a first, an AI model just surpassed the limit of what humans have ever done: calculating an amplitude in quantum field theory to nine-loop order.

There have been fantastic improvements since then, with Claude Fable, running 5.1 and in science mode, achieving theoretical results that even professionals in even more advanced fields were unable to make.
